description: Implementation of the ProductReviewService interface, providing business logic for handling product reviews, including creating reviews and retrieving them by customer, product, or both. It manages review ratings and updates product review statistics accordingly.

classes.name: ProductReviewServiceImpl
classes.description: Service implementation handling product review operations, including creation and retrieval, alongside updating product review statistics.

methods.name: getByCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves a list of reviews associated with a specific customer.

methods.name: getByProduct
methods.description: Retrieves a list of reviews associated with a specific product.

methods.name: getByProductAndCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves a review associated with both a specific product and customer.

methods.name: getByProduct
methods.description: Retrieves a list of reviews for a product in a specific language.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new product review and updates the product’s average rating and review count accordingly.
